note: BH-6433. The waits before each re-read of an autoenqueue ledger read that answers rc 1 (unusable), space separated: 2 5 10 is four reads. 1 to 5 integers, each 0..60; anything else is read as 2 5 10 and logged once a tick. A config fault (no-secret, no-url) is read once. MC_AE_LEDGER_RETRY=0 and the burst alert still mean one read. Settings key lane.merge-conductor.mc_ae_ledger_backoff.
